name: Maya Lin
bio: Designing sustainable daylight-filled spaces by day, hunting for Japanese pour-over beans and darkroom prints by weekend.

preferences.looking_for: A curious creative partner for gallery walks & deep midnight chats
preferences.communication_style: Thoughtful voice notes and spontaneous coffee invites

name: Julian Vance
bio: Wheel-throwing stoneware, collecting mid-century Scandinavian furniture, and brewing single-origin Ethiopia Guji.

preferences.looking_for: Someone who appreciates slow mornings, tactile art, and good design

name: Elena Rostova
bio: Searching for subtle human stories in archives. Always down for late-night repertory screenings and 35mm street film runs.

preferences.looking_for: An introspective collaborator and fellow visual storyteller

name: Kaelen Chen
bio: Mapping native flora across pocket parks, fermentation experiments in ceramic crocks, and climbing V5 problems.

preferences.looking_for: Kind souls who aren't afraid of dirt on their hands or vulnerability in conversation

name: Siddharth Mehta
bio: Obsessed with room acoustics, Japanese ambient music, and high-fidelity soundscapes. Making pour-overs with clinical precision.

preferences.looking_for: Someone to listen to whole albums with from start to finish without speaking

name: Nora Lindqvist
bio: Natural indigo dyeing, Scandinavian minimalism, and scouring flea markets for hand-loomed wool blankets.

preferences.looking_for: Someone with an eye for texture, color, and quiet moments

name: Tariq Al-Mansoor
bio: Writing long-form essays on urban planning and civic memory. Espresso enthusiast, chess amateur, and weekend gravel cyclist.

preferences.looking_for: Intellectual sparring partner with a generous heart

name: Chloe Dupont
bio: Curating emerging post-conceptual painters. Monotype printing in my shared studio. Believer in long dinners with natural wine.

preferences.looking_for: A lover of the arts who enjoys opening nights and debate on aesthetic theory

name: Marcus Sterling
bio: Restoring rare letterpress editions. If you like the smell of old paper, hand-sewn leather spines, and mechanical typewriters, we will get along.

preferences.looking_for: An old soul living in the present

name: Aria Takahashi
bio: Bridging kinetic sculpture with soft robotics. When away from solder irons, I am bouldering outdoors in the Gunks or hosting game nights.

preferences.looking_for: Playful, enthusiastic minds who love building things from scratch

name: Mateo Morales
bio: 100-hour laminated doughs, naturally leavened sourdoughs, and tracking heirloom Mexican heirloom corn varieties.

preferences.looking_for: Someone to taste test experimental pastries and share hearty weekend feasts

name: Zoe Kravitz-Miller
bio: Watercolors of medicinal herbs, rooftop honeybees, and foraging along Hudson River walkways. Lover of quiet museums on rainy Tuesdays.

preferences.looking_for: Gentle, authentic connections centered on creativity and mutual care

name: Leo Thorne
bio: Crafting speculative fiction novels about solarpunk futures. Avid tabletop strategist and lover of loose-leaf oolong tea.

preferences.looking_for: A co-adventurer who enjoys world-building and hypothetical moral quandaries

name: Camila O'Connor
bio: Exploring somatic awareness through contemporary dance. Bouldering, cycling across bridges at sunset, and catching independent dance films.

preferences.looking_for: Someone with vibrant energy who loves staying active and being present in the body

name: Dante Rossi
bio: Traveling to biodynamic vineyards in Piedmont and Sicily. Making handmade pasta from scratch and hunting for rare vintage Italian design books.

preferences.looking_for: A fellow epicurean who loves four-hour weekend dinners with rich stories

name: Freja Holm
bio: Obsessed with ergonomics, tactile surfaces, and timeless utilitarian objects. Bouldering, dark roast pour-overs, and Danish cinema.

preferences.looking_for: Someone mindful, deliberate, and captivated by intentional living
